description: This file contains template meta-programming utility classes for Google Mock, including matcher tuple definitions, function traits, and internal utilities used in implementing Google Mock.

classes.name: IgnoredValue
classes.description: A utility class that can be implicitly constructed from any value, used in implementing IgnoreResult actions.

methods.name: MatcherTuple
methods.description: Template struct that maps a tuple type to a tuple of matchers for each element.

methods.name: Function
methods.description: Template struct that extracts traits from function types, including return type, argument types, and related typedefs.
